g.title: submission_scheme
g.text: Submission and worker scheme: controller, CANFAR headless workers, and the track database on /arc

g.title: cluster_controller
g.text: Controller: one headless session (vla-orch image, flexible resources)

g.title: cluster_workers
g.text: Worker sessions: headless, one per (EB, stage, attempt), no replicas

g.title: ctrl
g.text: 5. write attempt_<k>.json, then Session.create(), then record IDs

g.title: db
g.text: Track database (controller is the only writer)

g.title: api
g.text: Session API: create · fetch · info · logs · events
finished headless records are kept ~1 h
(smoke test: record returned 404 after the run)

g.title: ctrl->api
g.text: create(name, image, cores, ram, env, cmd)
fetch() each cycle; info / logs / events at first terminal sighting

g.title: tracks
g.text: iter_<n>/logs/attempt_<k>/ (worker logs live; controller adds platform logs)

g.title: w_stage
g.text: unpack NRAO tar or wget → raw/<SDM>

g.title: w_rules
g.text: • exits 0 if a valid result.json already exists
• takes worker.lock (O_EXCL, holds its session ID)
• tees stdout + CASA logs to /arc as it runs
• writes via partial names, then renames
